obernants.approximation_semantics: Exact relation target with finite correspondence evidence; no numerical surrogate claim.
obernants.assumptions: Standard Rust semantics, available allocation, and stated bounded domain. Finite checks are not a universal proof.
obernants.domain: Inclusive u64 intervals and Result<Vec<u64>,SieveError>; accepted low<=high<=10^12 with width<=10^6.
obernants.operator: Excluded successful outputs contain any composite, omit a prime in the interval, include values outside the interval, or have duplicate/unsorted values. Rejected-domain success and wrong validation precedence are excluded.

obernants.operator: For a nonempty output list, compatible accepted intervals contain all those primes and no additional primes. Their endpoints can move in adjacent composite gaps. Empty outputs reconstruct prime-free accepted intervals, not a unique interval: [14,16] and [24,28]. Error fibers follow reversed/high/width precedence.
